1879-2105-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1879-2105-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2105-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

240-4927-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4927-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

6495-6553-8207.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6553-8207.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-1251-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

833-1059-3147-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3147-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Azorius Chancery, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4659-7492.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional creature that can be sacrificed by Krark-Clan Ironworks and which will cause Arnyn to trigger.
3097-3490-4659-7492.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

3197-6830-7743-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6830-7743-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

511-560-817-4050-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2511-4986-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
2511-4986-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

141-2921-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

270-1661-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

224-1671-3314-3430-6664.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-1671-3314-3430-6664.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

632-1322-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1322-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

647-1308-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-3129-5742-5743.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart, adding {B}.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-969-2511.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-813-1987.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1479-2719-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

527-2292-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-2292-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-2292-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Selvala, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-2292-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1575-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1575-4321.description:
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and three tapped Food tokens.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

527-4068-4790.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
You control at least one Mountain.
527-4068-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

1283-2034-2208-4230.description:
Cast Charming Scoundrel by paying {2}.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Charming Scoundrel, adding {2}.
Charming Scoundrel is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard due to Necromancer's Magemark.
The Wicked Role token that was attached to Charming Scoundrel triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

575-1045-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
575-1045-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Horde Ambusher, adding {C}{C}.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Yedora triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Horde Ambusher by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3987-4935.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell this turn.
2034-2724-3987-4935.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
Wormfang Manta dies, triggering its second ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, allowing you to cast Wormfang Manta from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta enters the batltefield, but its first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

3244-4724.notablePrerequisites: You have at least twenty creatures in library.
3244-4724.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mortal Combat triggers, causing you to win the game.

1962-3767-3784.notablePrerequisites: Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
1962-3767-3784.description:
Cast Sheilds of Velis Vel by paying {W}, causing all creatures you control to get +0/+1 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Vhal by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-3818.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3490-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Sengir, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
